concept: Inspector: vulnerability scanning for EC2 and container images
tests: Which service automatically scans EC2 and container images for software vulnerabilities and network exposure.
expected: Amazon Inspector — continuous scanning of EC2 and ECR images for CVEs and network reachability. Triggers: "software vulnerabilities", "container images", "unintended network exposure".
why_not: Macie — sensitive data in S3; Shield — DDoS; WAF — web request filtering.
